ayahs.ar: قُلْ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْاٰنًا عَجَبًا ۝١ۙ
ayahs.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: يَّهْدِيْٓ اِلَي الرُّشْدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ وَلَنْ نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا͏ٓ اَحَدًا ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰي جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًا ۝٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ سَفِيْهُنَا عَلَي اللّٰهِ شَطَطًا ۝٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا͏ٓ اَنْ لَّنْ تَقُوْلَ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا ۝٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ يَعُوْذُوْنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوْهُمْ رَهَقًا ۝٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنْ لَّنْ يَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًا ۝٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِي͏ٔ͏َتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيْدًا وَّشُهُبًا ۝٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِؕ فَمَنْ يَّسْتَمِعِ الْاٰنَ يَجِدْ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا ۝٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدْرِيْٓ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيْدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا ۝١٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوْنَ وَمِنَّا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَؕ كُنَّا طَرَا࢜ىِٕقَ قِدَدًا ۝١١ۙ
ayahs.tr: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا͏ٓ اَنْ لَّنْ نُّعْجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُّعْجِزَهٗ هَرَبًا ۝١٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدٰٓي اٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ فَمَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنْۢ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًا ۝١٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ وَمِنَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَؕ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ فَكَانُوْا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا ۝١٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنْ لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوْا عَلَي الطَّرِيْقَةِ لَاَسْقَيْنٰهُمْ مَّا࢜ءً غَدَقًا ۝١٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

ayahs.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِؕ وَمَنْ يُّعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا ۝١٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّ الْمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًا ۝١٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ يَدْعُوْهُ كَادُوْا يَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا ۝١٩ؕࣖ
ayahs.tr: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

ayahs.ar: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّيْ وَلَا͏ٓ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖٓ اَحَدًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

ayahs.ar: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَا͏ٓ اَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

ayahs.ar: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَنْ يُّجِيْرَنِيْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ࣢ۙ وَّلَنْ اَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًا ۝٢٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖؕ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا͏ٓ اَبَدًا ۝٢٣ؕ
ayahs.tr: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰٓي اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ فَسَيَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

ayahs.ar: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِيْٓ اَقَرِيْبٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ اَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّيْٓ اَمَدًا ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

ayahs.ar: عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلٰي غَيْبِهٖٓ اَحَدًا ۝٢٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضٰي مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسْلُكُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ رَصَدًا ۝٢٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

ayahs.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ اَبْلَغُوْا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَاَحْصٰي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا ۝٢٨ࣖ
ayahs.tr: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
